---
title: "Top-level image size does not override the open-graph size"
image: square.svg
image-width: 1200
image-height: 630
open-graph:
  image-width: 10
  image-height: 10
_quarto:
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/square.svg">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:width" content="10">'
          - '<meta property="og:image:height" content="10">'
        -
          - 'og:image:width" content="1200"'
          - 'og:image:height" content="630"'
---

Quarto cannot measure an SVG, so the size declared under open-graph is emitted, and the top-level image-width and image-height are ignored.
